name: present
description: Terminal picker for humans and JSON ask/answer protocol for agents — one binary, two faces
input: either --ask "<message>" --options '<json-array>' as flags, or {"message","options"} on stdin with --json, or no args in a tty to browse the shelf
output: the picked option on stdout (plain) or {"choice":"a"} (json), or the module command running (browse mode)

cost.detail: local binary, no network, no api
